cases.label: Missing branch
cases.description: One branch is absent from the testing map. Unmatched crack length contributes to the difference score.

cases.label: Identical maps
cases.description: The same vector map is used twice: all four attributes agree.

cases.label: Small displacement
cases.description: All testing segments are shifted three pixels to the right, while the reference stays fixed.

cases.label: Extra branch
cases.description: An additional, disconnected segment appears in the testing map. It is counted as unmatched length.

cases.label: Wider & longer
cases.description: Existing cracks widen and extend at their tips. The original paths stay in place; no disconnected crack is added. Widths are doubled along existing nonzero-width points. This is a synthetic growth example, not a deterioration forecast.
